title: Camera Configuration & ROI Editor

steps.action: Logged in as Admin and opened Camera & thiết bị
steps.expected: Camera Settings is accessible and stream is online
steps.actual: Camera cổng vào and Camera cổng ra are visible with Live từ bridge

steps.action: Updated camera stream URL, lane and ROI note, then saved
steps.actual: The UI displayed Đã cập nhật thiết bị camera.; values persisted after reopening the form

steps.action: Attempted to open ROI editor and drag ROI coordinates
steps.expected: ROI editor is available on the Camera Settings screen
steps.actual: No ROI editor/open ROI control is exposed in the current /devices UI; only Test, Chỉnh sửa, Xóa and Restart are available

steps.action: Attempted to save ROI coordinates and verify AI OCR handoff
steps.expected: ROI coordinates are saved and sent to AI OCR service
steps.actual: Cannot execute from the screen because the ROI editor is not wired into the Camera & thiết bị page

limitation: Camera configuration persistence works, but the ROI editor flow required by ADD_05 is not reachable from the current UI. The repository contains an RoiEditor component and PATCH /api/devices/:id/roi endpoint, but the devices page does not expose a control to launch it.
